title: Community Media: Main Exam, 20 April 2018
department: Department of Journalism and Mass Communication
programme: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Name five community radios in Kenya.
List any five sources of financial support to community media.
Describe any five advantages of community radio.
Discuss any five challenges of running a community-owned media.

items.text: Explain the main differences between community media and commercial media in terms of ownership and management.
Community media has distinct characteristics that make it stand out from the rest of the forms of media. Describe any five of these characteristics.
Assess the impact of community media in today's society.
Describe any ten ways through which community media helps promote democracy and champion human rights in Africa.

programmes: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
